newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dadonghai set to list 80 mln B shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Dadonghai set to list 80 mln B shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Hainan Dadonghai Tourism Centre (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Friday it had won approval to list 80 million B shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange on October 8.
The securities code for the stock has been set as "2613.SZ", Dadonghai said in a listing notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

The offer, launched at HK$1.22 a share last month, gave a price/earnings ratio of 6.41 times based on 1996 projected per-share net profits of 0.205 yuan. This was calculated on a fully diluted basis under international accounting standards, Dadonghai said.
It said Shanghai Guotai Securities had been appointed to promote the listing.
The offer had been more than five times oversubscribed, a Guotai offial said by telephone.

Dadonghai, based in the seaside resort of Sanya on Hainan island, said it would channel proceeds from the B share offer into renovating its wholly-owned subsidiary, the four-star, 238-room South China Sea Grand Hotel.

Dadonghai currently has total share capital of 320 million shares, including 101.07 million founder shares, 108.93 million legal person shares, 80 million B shares and 30 million internal staff shares, according to the listing notice.

The firm's B share offer prospectus said Dadonghai planned to follow the listing of its B shares with an application to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 14 million class A shares.
The A shares were slated to be listed in Shenzhen, it said.

Dadonghai said in the listing notice that under international accounting standards, it had forecast net earnings of 63 million yuan for this year, compared with 39.90 million yuan in 1995 and 32.73 million yuan the previous year.
It added that it chalked up net earnings of 9.33 million yuan in the first quarter of this year. It did not give a comparative figure.
